name: Robert Parsons
abstract_title: Abstract: M-Energy Consciousness: A Grand Unification and TOE Framework Integrating Forces, Gravity, and Awareness
abstract: Grand Unification Theories (GUTs) merge the three gauge forces and aim to incorporate gravity, yet they universally overlook consciousness. This proposal introduces M-Energy (Modulated Energy), a coherence-driven scalar field Φ that unifies all four forces plus awareness in a Theory of Everything (TOE). The model originates from MENERGY, an exploratory extension of Einstein’s E = mc² to G_E = mc² φ, where φ is a dimensionless coherence factor accounting for reported ~0.1–1% mass anomalies under
